name: dogfood-security-siem-incident-app
description: Dogfood app v1.39-3 — a Splunk + PagerDuty style SIEM + incident response orchestrator (CIM-formatted structured audit log + tamper-evident hash-chain seal + hot/warm/cold retention + correlation rule + playbook trigger + sev1-5 severity classification + escalation + forensics capture + post-mortem + fused SIEM-to-incident orchestrator) that drives a SIEM + incident response surface backed by @kiwa-test/security v0.2 siem-audit + incident-response semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_SIEM_ENDPOINT + KIWA_PAGERDUTY_URL + KIWA_LOKI_URL provider endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/security -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
